label: Tryptophan Metabolism and Aryl-Hydrocarbon Receptor Agonists in the Gut Microbiome of People With Myalgic Encephalomyelitis/Chronic Fatigue Syndrome.
summary: Myalgic encephalomyelitis/chronic fatigue syndrome (ME/CFS) is a debilitating chronic disease with unknown biological basis and no cure. Microbiome dysbiosis has been reported in people with ME/CFS but its relevance to pathophysiology is unknown. Gut microbes are an important source of tryptophan metabolites that activate the aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AHR), a regulator of homeostatic and inflammatory genes.
